annotations.title: Question sheet for your own purchasing help

description: AICTIONBOT™ question sorter by KULIC Advisory (tool 73). Takes the questions people ask about buying (from training, mail, chat or notes), each with its answer where one exists, and returns a question sheet: sorted into nine fixed topics (access, ordering, approval, delivery, invoice, suppliers, contracts, who to ask, other), near-identical questions merged with a count, the answer next to each question, open questions marked with the Workbench tool that helps, the topic with the most questions and the next step. Deterministic keyword rules, no AI, nothing stored. It sorts your questions and answers and does not write answers itself. To find recurring causes in a list of problems use analyse_issues. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

rows.description: One row per question: question, answer (may be empty). German column names work too (frage, antwort).
